note: presentation only: who receives the creator fee, shown next to the holder rows; never an engine input, never changes a FLAG, verdict or threshold and never counts toward NO_ALARM
cannot_see: only the canonical PumpSwap pool's creator fee (the pool pump.fun's migrate creates, found from the coin's bonding curve, the SOL-pair derivation and Dexscreener's pair list; other PumpSwap pools pay no creator fee) and the fee-sharing split; not who signs the claims or cranks the payouts (that needs transaction history), not where a recipient sends the fees next, not creator fees on the pump.fun bonding curve before graduation, and no other launchpad (not supported); when the bonding curve cannot be read, a pool paired with a token Dexscreener did not list is not checked; one read at read time, no history: an admin that is not revoked can still set the shareholders once, and pump.fun's community-takeover instruction (admin_cto_sharing_config in the cached pump_fees IDL, argument new_admin) can still set a new config admin even after 'admin revoked: yes'
